admin_logbooks_owner_hint: The callsign of a user on this instance. Owners add the other members themselves.
admin_logbooks_no_user: No active user has that callsign on this instance.
admin_logbooks_delete_description: Its {count} QSOs, Stations, Instruments, Members and export batches go with it. A snapshot of the database is written first.
admin_users_callsign_hint: The personal callsign the user signs in as. It cannot be changed later.
admin_users_role_hint: Admins manage users, Logbooks and the server. Reading a Logbook still needs a membership.
admin_users_added: Added {callsign}. Send them the registration link.
admin_users_exists: That callsign already has a user.
admin_users_disable_description: They can no longer sign in. Their sessions, API tokens and unused registration link are deleted, and enabling them again restores none of these. Their QSOs and memberships stay.
admin_users_registration_hint: A link for the user to register a passkey on their device, valid for 24 hours. Issuing one replaces their unused link; a lost device is replaced the same way.
admin_users_registration_disabled: Enable the user to issue a link.
admin_users_link_shown_once: Send this link to {callsign}. It is shown only now.
admin_users_link_copy_failed: The link could not be copied. Select it and copy it by hand.
admin_users_remove_passkey_description: {callsign} can no longer sign in with {name}.
admin_users_remove_passkey_last: It is their last passkey: they cannot sign in until they register another with a registration link.
admin_reference_cty_hint: Drop a CTY zip archive (Big CTY or the contest files from country-files.com) or choose one
admin_reference_cty_too_large: The archive is larger than {max} MiB.
